connections.intro: Keys are stored on this computer and never shown again. Production and design language creation run on these keys; usage is paid.

use.anthropic: Daily production (design, candidate picking, reading text in images) and design language creation.
use.gemini: Image generation: backgrounds and pictures for labels.

connections.notEncrypted: Could not be encrypted on disk
connections.newKeyHint: Get the key at {{where}}. The field is cleared once saved.
connections.tooShort: The key must be at least 8 characters.
connections.confirmBody: Without it, this service cannot be used for production. You can enter a new one any time.
connections.platformIntro: AI keys are kept on the SellerOnData platform.
connections.platformBody: The platform admin enters the keys; this company does not need its own. Spending is shown in Hub, under the subscription.

production.intro: Defaults used when orders are produced. Changes are saved right away.

variants.label: Default number of variations
variants.hint: How many variations a run saves. More means more choice and more cost.

language.label: Default design language

concurrency.label: Jobs produced at once
concurrency.hint: A higher value is faster but may hit the AI service's rate limit. 1–8.

fonts.missingHelp: Upload the file below; its name must match the one in the profile.

sample.label: Sample text

own.title: Fonts of this language
own.empty: No fonts uploaded to this language yet.

fonts.badType: Only .ttf, .otf, .woff and .woff2 files can be uploaded.

cost.intro: Estimated cost of AI calls. Amounts come from the price list; your invoice may differ slightly.
